scope: SPEC-0012 source, CI-hardening follow-ups, and sequential Ubuntu Node 24 stability samples through 4ff806c

remediationCommits.subject: test: wait for subprocess readiness
addresses: poll late Claude resource release instead of sleeping 250 ms
wait for the host listening marker instead of socket-file existence

remediationCommits.subject: test: harden bounded lifecycle checks
addresses: start the 300 ms host-stop observation after child readiness
allow 15 s for the disk-heavy crash child and report child.error
use a scoped 10 s state wait
collect bounded GC batches until the asserted tombstone

remediationCommits.subject: test: bound subprocess readiness
addresses: reject readiness on child error or early exit and cap it at 5 s
apply a 30 s default node:test timeout without changing the test file set or concurrency

remediationCommits.subject: test: gate embedded shutdown fixture
addresses: replace a fixed 400 ms embedded-shutdown delay with an explicit terminal gate
assert that shutdown begins only after the fixture reaches running

remediationCommits.subject: test: control Claude deadline boundary
addresses: replace a 1 ms wall-clock assumption with a controlled execution-budget sequence
assert that the query was submitted before expecting an unknown outcome

remediationCommits.subject: test: bound owner EOF cleanup fixture
addresses: allow five seconds for owner EOF cleanup on a loaded runner while retaining the ten-second RPC boundary
raise only the test wrapper timeout; production TERM/KILL cleanup budgets remain unchanged

attributionBoundary: The cancelled 5645d3a job has no downloadable log archive. Its exact last test is unknown; the 8ee5078 mapping is a bounded-harness correction followed by final GREEN, not proof of the cancelled job's precise internal wait.

subsequentEvidence.method: The GitHub App job-rerun endpoint returned 403, so each additional sample used a temporary immutable tag pointing at the exact commit. Runs were sequential. All 20 temporary tags were deleted after evidence capture, and a remote tag query returned empty.

failure.test: AC07 drain timeout keeps the client and shutdown operation recoverable
Claude observes next rejection when acceptance deadline expired before wait registration
failure.cause: A 1 ms wall-clock budget could expire before query submission on a loaded runner; the test assumed that submission had already happened.

failure.test: 0003-A real owner EOF reaps its Codex initialize child, preserves outcome on restart, and leaves another process alive
failure.error: Owner EOF exceeded test cleanup deadline
failure.cause: A two-second wall-clock owner-exit assertion did not hold under shared-runner scheduling load, although the intended semantic boundary is the ten-second RPC deadline.

subsequentEvidence.interpretation: The final SHA passed the selected high-risk job ten times and all six workflow jobs in each run. This is a bounded flake sample, not a production latency or SLO guarantee.
